# CircuitTopologyEncoding

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A graph-based representation that encodes interconnect nodes, links, and routing rules as a genotype for evolutionary operators. Defines the search space expressiveness and directly impacts the feasibility of synthesizing manufacturable TCC hardware.
